resources.string: Sends the HOME button to the Vestor home screen instead of Amazon\'s, and shows notes and the bike alarm over other apps. It reads no screen content.

Speak to Ask Vestor from your phone: choose Speak on your phone in the Ask box and your words show on the TV as you talk. A 3D bike map, BU Law and Pardee docks on the bikes card, and the info bar and Settings fit the screen.
